ods-migrate configurator

ods-migrate moves your code to ODS v20 with the Aluminium look, the v20 default, and adds nothing to keep the v19 look. Some v20 changes alter what users see without any change in your code. For each of them, this page shows the v19 rendering, the v20 Aluminium rendering, and the v20 rendering with the v19 look kept, so you can choose.

Aluminium is the recommended choice everywhere. Keep the v19 look only where it matters to your users, then download ods-migrate.config.json to the root of your project, where you run ods-migrate.

Colours: the v20 renderings use the default Aluminium theme, whose accent is navy. Keeping the v19 look restores a shape or an emphasis, not the v19 blue. For the blue, load the blue-jeans theme of ODS v20 instead of the default one (import '@ovhcloud/ods-themes/blue-jeans/css' in place of default/css: one theme only, the last one loaded wins), which ods-migrate never changes.

Your config


    

      
Your v19-look stylesheet, written by ods-migrate --write

      

      
Import it once, after the ODS theme, for example from your app entry point. Keep it outside any CSS @layer, even if your project puts every other style in one: the ODS theme is not in a layer, so a rule inside one always loses to it.

    

    
Run it

    
From the root of your project (or of your repository), where you put ods-migrate.config.json. The full procedure is in MIGRATION.md.

    
npx @ovhcloud/ods-migrate .              # dry run: prints what it would change, writes nothing
npx @ovhcloud/ods-migrate . --write      # applies the changes and writes your v19-look stylesheet

    
Until ods-migrate is published, run it from a checkout of the design-system repository: replace npx @ovhcloud/ods-migrate with node <checkout>/packages/ods-migrate/src/cli.mjs.

    
Lint with the same choices

    
// eslint.config.js
import config from './ods-migrate.config.json' with { type: 'json' };
// …
rules: { 'ods/v20-migration': ['error', { look: config.look }], 'ods/v20-tokens': ['error', { look: config.look }] }
